about_the_game:
Can you make your great escape without the boss catching you?

In Exit Strategy, you're a office worker looking for the ultimate clock-out: escaping early without getting caught. Use stealth, clever distractions, and your environment to outsmart your boss and find your way to freedom.

🔍 Features:

  • 🧠 Stealth Puzzle Gameplay: Slip past supervisors, duck into vents, distract coworkers, and escape.

  • 🛠️ Steam Workshop Support: Build your own custom maps and share them with the community.

  • 🗂️ Office-Themed Mayhem: Navigate copy rooms, cubicles, break rooms, and boss offices.

  • 🏆 Community Challenges (PLANNED but NOT IMPLEMENTED YET): Compete on leaderboards and beat the trickiest user-created maps.

  • 💼 Multiple Escape Routes: Every map has creative paths—find the fastest or the weirdest one!

Whether you're hiding under desks, in a paper box or knocking over the water cooler to create a distraction, every level is a mini sandbox.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti or equivalent
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+ 64-bit (latest version)
  • Processor: 8-core Intel i7/i9 or AMD Ryzen 7/9
  • Memory: 32 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 Super or equivalent
  • Storage: 950 MB available space

short_description: Escape the office! Create and share your own stealth puzzles. Crawl past coworkers, trigger distractions, and outsmart middle management in Exit Strategy.
